purpose: Freeze the final Hero site-consumer boundary after Stage 6-3 full generation. Production page code must consume the sharded Hero detail publication and the closed Stage B byHero ownership index without reopening Stage 4/5/ConfigData semantics or duplicating relation logic.

exclusiveEquipment.currentCardinality: ZERO_OR_ONE exclusive Equipment per canonical Hero

heroDetail.resolution: Resolve the exact numeric heroId in hero-detail.v1.json storage.byHeroId. Load only that shard for the detail route. Unknown IDs return the public not-found state; never search Stage 4/5 or ConfigData as fallback.

composition.identityHeaderNormalBondsCentralSp: Use the selected Hero shard as the canonical materialized payload for identity, presentation, normal combat, bonds, centralDiscipline and sp blocks.
composition.soldiers: Use shard.soldiers.ids as the frozen Hero-Soldier membership and resolve display metadata from hero-detail-shared.v1.json#soldiersById. Do not rebuild Hero-Soldier membership in page code.

exclusiveEquipment.ownershipStep: Resolve ownership membership only from B-5 byHeroId.
exclusiveEquipment.absenceSemantics: A canonical Hero missing from byHeroId has no released exclusive Equipment in the accepted snapshot. Render the not-released/absent state; do not infer an Equipment.
exclusiveEquipment.metadataStep: When byHeroId returns one equipmentId, join that exact ID to Equipment Stage 3-5 exclusive detail metadata.

uiContract.normalSpInitialState: Normal form is the default on page entry/re-entry. SP form may be toggled only when shard.sp.status == RELEASED.
uiContract.presentationReviewPolicy: Presentation-only REVIEW remains renderable/site-usable. Null Korean display metadata may fall back for display but must not be written back as verified source data.
uiContract.assetBoundary: Source asset paths are data identifiers only. Web-delivery conversion/extraction belongs to the later frontend/asset integration step and does not reopen Hero semantic data.

forbiddenProductionReadsOrDerivations: Stage 4 or Stage 5 producer outputs as runtime page inputs
Stage 6-1 composition locators as runtime page inputs
data/generated/hero-exclusive-equipment-relations.v1.json as a page lookup when the admitted byHero index exists
ConfigDataEquipmentInfo.SkillHero direct reads in Hero page code
legacy Stage 5-2 ownerHeroId/ownerResolver as production ownership authority
Hero-Soldier membership re-derivation from SoldierInfo/SP relations
ownership inference from names, descriptions, icons, ArmyIds/JobIds, numeric patterns, sorting or chronology

nonDuplication.reason: Stage 6-3 already freezes one canonical shard per Hero, and Stage B already freezes the minimal byHero/byEquipment projections. Stage 6-4 freezes consumption and validation rather than copying those payloads again.

publicationGate: Hero Stage 6-3 is COMPLETE with 267/267 site-usable Hero records, zero structural FAIL and zero hard errors.
All 267 manifest entries resolve to one existing Hero shard whose SHA-256 and heroId match the manifest.
The shared Soldier payload SHA-256 matches the manifest and every referenced Soldier ID resolves in soldiersById.
Stage B final is PASS_ACCEPTED and closed, and B-6 consumer admission is COMPLETE with zero hard errors.
B byHero/byEquipment indexes round-trip the same 167 ownership pairs.
All 167 B-owned equipment IDs resolve in Equipment Stage 3-5 exclusive detail metadata.
Each materialized Hero shard's embedded exclusiveEquipment snapshot has exact parity with B byHero membership after treating absent/not-released as no relation.
No runtime fallback to ConfigData, Stage 4, Stage 5, Stage 6-1 or heuristic relationship reconstruction is admitted.

freezeDecision.nextScope: Frontend/UI and web-asset integration may consume this contract. Semantic producer stages remain frozen unless a new source snapshot or explicit contradiction requires their owning stage to be reopened.
